{{Vanilla|Bastion Remnant}}
A '''bastion remnant''' generates in [[Hell]] as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot, adding [[Ruby|rubies]] and diamond equipment. Bastions are the main source of [[Adamant Scrap]]; the developer calls the [[Abbey]] the overworld's equivalent for silver.
